title: TNLX-Pack
body:
TNLX-Pack is a 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack centered around **Create**, with many extras:
- New world generation
- New structures
- Loads of extra food
- New mobs
- Gravestones
- Seasons
- New building blocks
- Furniture
- Better archeology
- Artifacts
- New weapons and combat system
- Better particles and sounds
- Cosmetic armor
